clarification: The strictly-positive pooled-cell criterion applies to every source pool that is actually fitted: the full global, adult, and pediatric pools and, within each of eight leave-one-donor-out folds, the training-global pool and each nonempty training age stratum.
reason: A coordinate available in the full source pool can be unavailable in a seven-donor training pool if the omitted donor supplied its only positive cell. The frozen unregularized Poisson comparator must therefore be finite in every cross-validation fit as well as the final fit.
